'''Raveen''' was an individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Major/Legends|major]] of [[Sith Intelligence]] around [[3638 BBY]]. They were the military intelligence coordinator for the [[Aida sector/Legends|Aida sector]], which included the then-vital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Makeb]].<ref name="Lurker Status" />

==Biography==
During the Sith Empire's secret [[Conquest of Makeb|mission to Makeb]], the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] code-named [[Tyvar|Lurker]] was eliminated by an Imperial operative due to his cover having been compromised. Raveen would later express their discontent through a message to the operative. Despite their rank, Raveen was completely unaware of the Sith Empire's actions on Makeb, and as such questioned the removal of one of the few intelligence assets within the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Lurker Status" />
